subject: [PATCH 08/22] mm/memory-tiers: restrict demotion topology to common memory

2026-11-14.patch_summary: This patch restricts the demotion topology in Linux's memory-tiers to only consider common memory (N_MEMORY_COMMON). It achieves this by modifying several functions that build demotion paths and assign nodes to memory tiers, ensuring that these operations are limited to nodes within N_MEMORY_COMMON. This change does not affect existing behavior for nodes carrying N_MEMORY_COMMON, as all current nodes do so. The patch aims to improve the management of memory allocation and demotion in the Linux kernel by reducing unnecessary complexity and potential issues related to non-common memory nodes.
